records.title: Stickybeak · Microservices Commerce
records.abstract: An e-commerce platform for Australian souvenirs and regional specialities. A React storefront and administration console connect to Spring Cloud microservices for product search, carts, Stripe sandbox payments and order fulfilment.
findings: React 18, Redux Toolkit and Tailwind CSS power the storefront; Ant Design provides the administration console.
Spring Cloud Gateway connects authentication, product, cart, order, payment and notification services, with MySQL, Redis and Elasticsearch for storage, caching and search.
Stripe sandbox payments validate webhook signatures and track events in the database to handle duplicate notifications.
An order state machine governs payment, dispatch, completion and cancellation; RabbitMQ carries order events for timeout cancellation and email notifications.
Includes Docker Compose environments, backend tests and Playwright end-to-end check scripts.

records.title: Acknowledgements · Inspiration & collaboration
records.department: OPEN SOURCE · VISUAL INSPIRATION · AI COLLABORATION
records.abstract: This personal website grew from open-source generosity, an appreciation of Rhine Lab’s visual world, and collaboration between a person and AI. This final archive is a thank-you to those inspirations and contributions.
findings: Thank you to LBEILC for sharing RhineLabUI, providing an open-source foundation to learn from and build upon.
Thank you to HYPERGRYPH and the creators of Arknights. Rhine Lab’s visual design, glass archives and research-terminal atmosphere inspired this interface.
Thank you to OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra and Codex for supporting implementation, debugging, modelling scripts and ongoing iteration.
This tribute retains the original Rhine glass, twin-ring interior and RHINE LAB lettering as a nod to the original work and its open-source adaptation.

sections.title: Open-source and visual origins
sections.abstract: From the original visual work to its open-source recreation and this personal adaptation, each contribution deserves acknowledgement.
findings: RhineLabUI: the open-source interface by LBEILC, providing the foundation for this website’s interface and 3D interactions.
Arknights and Rhine Lab: the work and visual world created by HYPERGRYPH.
